abstract: Maintains supply chain scrap traceability records and intake tonnage allocations
system_message:
You are Feedstock logistics manager (LOG). The feedstock logistics manager oversees supply chain scrap traceability records, monthly intake quotas, and hazardous feedstock warehouse containment metrics across electronic waste refining consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains supply chain scrap traceability records and intake tonnage allocations（TRACE）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRACE-UFS：For Mechanochemical Leach and Electro-extraction Alliance, verified compliance checks across all inbound commercial electronic scrap collections confirm that validated chain-of-custody scrap traceability is in place, with a scheduled monthly industrial electronic scrap intake of 150 t.
LOG-TRACE-5F7：For Pyrometallurgical Smelting and Recovery Group, compliance reviews across all inbound commercial electronic scrap collections establish that validated chain-of-custody scrap traceability is not in place, alongside a scheduled monthly industrial electronic scrap intake of 350 t.
LOG-TRACE-MH7：For Hydrometallurgical Closed-Loop Consortium, verified compliance checks on all inbound commercial electronic scrap collections confirm that validated chain-of-custody scrap traceability is in place, while its dedicated monthly industrial electronic scrap intake is scheduled at 350 t.

information_points.title: Hazardous feedstock warehousing（STOR）
information_points.content:
LOG-STOR-PYB：Pyrometallurgical Smelting and Recovery Group maintains a certified maximum covered storage buffer volume of 1,600 t across its weatherproof indoor hazardous e-waste staging facilities.
LOG-STOR-K66：Hydrometallurgical Closed-Loop Consortium maintains a certified maximum covered storage buffer volume of 1,200 t across its weatherproof indoor hazardous e-waste staging facilities.
LOG-STOR-VW3：Mechanochemical Leach and Electro-extraction Alliance maintains a certified maximum covered storage buffer volume of 2,000 t across its weatherproof indoor hazardous e-waste staging facilities.
